system_rules: Assessment section performance must map to curriculum micro-skills rather than exist as a standalone score only.
A low paper score does not identify a root cause until item-level or rubric-level evidence is analysed.
For essay questions, infer weakness from rubric dimensions and observed writing features, not total mark alone.
For Kertas 2, each item may map to one primary and multiple secondary curriculum skills.
Do not back-propagate an exam error to lower forms unless the prerequisite graph has evidence of an actual gap.
If exact paper-format rules are updated by KPM/LP, update this assessment layer without rewriting the curriculum layer.
